subject_and_context: Real Star Point Garage workshop exterior or real service environment
fallback_if_missing: Use a clearly disclosed concept illustration; no generic stock photo may be labelled as the actual garage
notes: Owner must provide approved workshop image

subject_and_context: Actual wash correction detailing and coating process
fallback_if_missing: Omit fake gallery; use concise service diagrams or labelled stock context
notes: Each treatment image needs a true business source

visitor_question_or_business_job: Can I see real completed work?
subject_and_context: Actual Star Point Garage completed motorcycle jobs
fallback_if_missing: Do not use Pexels or Unsplash photos as the garage gallery
performance_target: local thumbnails plus approved full images

subject_and_context: Authentic short process video or sequence of actual details
fallback_if_missing: Use a static process diagram or omit video
performance_target: poster plus compressed muted video with controls
notes: Video needs commercial rights and any relevant releases
